relics.description.climbing_boots.descri: Fur-lined leather with steel crampons under the soles, made for the mountain roads. A ledge that would stop anyone else is just the next step.
relics.description.climbing_boots.abilit: Steps the wearer up ledges up to %1$s blocks high without jumping. Each ledge stepped up gives %2$s%% more speed for two seconds.
+1 experience point for each ledge stepped up
block.lsp_fixes.xp_bank.tooltip: Keeps %s of the XP machines within %s blocks earn while nobody is within %s blocks of them. Right-click it to take the XP, sneak-right-click to see what it holds.
item.lsp_fixes.xp_bank_upgrade.tooltip: Use it on a Tier %s XP Bank to make it Tier %s: it then keeps %s.
